question: Who among the following broke Shivnath Singh’s long-standing 48-year-old Indian national record at the Rotterdam Marathon 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sawan Barwal**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• **Sawan Barwal** created history by breaking the **48-year-old Indian national record** in the men's marathon during the **Rotterdam Marathon 2026**.

• The previous record was held by the legendary **Shivnath Singh**, who clocked a time of **2:12:00** in **1978** in **Jalandhar**.

• Shivnath Singh's mark was the longest-standing national record in **Indian athletics**, having remained untouched for nearly five decades despite numerous attempts by elite runners.

• Barwal's feat at the **Rotterdam Marathon**, a course known for its flat terrain and fast times in the **Netherlands**, marks a significant milestone in the evolution of long-distance running in India.

• This achievement solidifies **Sawan Barwal**'s position as a premier athlete in the **international marathon circuit**, moving the national benchmark to a new competitive level.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Shivnath Singh**:

• A legendary distance runner who represented India in the **1976 Montreal Olympics**, where he famously finished 11th.

• He was known for running barefoot and held the **national record** from **1978** until it was finally surpassed in 2026.

• **Gopi Thonakal**:

• The first Indian to win the **Asian Marathon Championship** gold medal in **2017**.

• He competed in the **2016 Rio Olympics** and has been a dominant figure in Indian marathon running for over a decade.

• **Nitendra Singh Rawat**:

• An elite **marathoner** from **Uttarakhand** who represented India at the **2016 Olympics**.

• He has won multiple titles at the **South Asian Games** and consistently ranked among the fastest Indian marathoners before the recent record-breaking events.
